summary.text: Tyler Dees was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and was sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 35, which includes the western part of Benton and Washington Counties.

paragraphs.text: He is vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and is Director of Business Development for Simmons Foods.
He played basketball in high school in Siloam Springs and then at John Brown University, and holds an undergraduate degree in business management, an MS in Leadership and Ethics, and an MBA.
He and his wife live in Siloam Springs and have three children.

sources.title: Biography of the Honorable Tyler Dees, Arkansas State Senator
